{{Quote|Your blade does not frighten me&mdash;I killed eight Jedi&mdash;and their Padawans&mdash;on the plains of Rullag.|Nax Cirvan, to Darth Vader|<ref name="GP4" />}}
'''Rullag''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Rullag system/Legends|Rullag system]], a part of the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="GP4" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Clone Wars Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] took place between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]-allied [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Nax Cirvan]] [[Death/Legends|eliminated]] eight [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] on Rullag's plains. Eventually, Cirvan was captured<ref name="GP4" /> by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="GP3">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 3]]</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and taken to [[The Prism]],<ref name="GP4" /> a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] operated by the Jedi Order.<ref name="GP3" />

In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="VaderDate">The various ''Darth Vader'' miniseries released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] date themselves to a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to early in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY]], thus placing the ''Darth Vader'' comics, including ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]'', in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]] as well.</ref> following the Clone Wars,<ref name="GP4" /> Skywalker, now known<ref name="Film III">{{Film|III}}</ref> as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, traveled to The Prism to recruit its [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to help overthrow a [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] occurring on<ref name="GP4" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After Vader caused a [[Mission to the Prism|riot]] to break out, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] encountered Cirvan, who announced he was not afraid of Vader. The Dark Jedi further explained to the Darth that he had killed eight Jedi on the plains of Rullag. Not long after, Vader acquired all the prisoners he needed, Cirvan included, to counter the takeover.<ref name="GP4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rullag was mentioned in the [[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|fourth issue]] of the [[2012]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''. The comic was written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="GP4" /> on [[August 22]], 2012.<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54123/star_wars_darth_vader_and_the_ghost_prison_2012_4|text=Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison (2012) #4}}</ref> The Rullag system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system, along with presumably the astronomical object Rullag, in grid square T-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
